[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended several agility drills to start with:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Shuttle runs: Set up two cones about 10 yards apart and run back and forth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. T-Drill: Set up three cones in a "T" shape and run around them in a specific pattern.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. 5-10-5 Shuttle: Set up three cones in a straight line with 5 yards between each and sprint between them.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Ladder drills: Use an agility ladder for various footwork drills.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Box drill: Set up four cones in a square for footwork and change of direction drills.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised warming up properly before starting agility drills and mastering movements at a slower pace before increasing speed.  
[USER] User asked for tips to avoid injury while doing agility drills.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips to avoid injury:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Warm-up properly with stretching and increasing heart rate.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Wear comfortable and supportive shoes designed for the training surface.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Focus on proper technique to prevent injuries, especially in knees and ankles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Don't overdo it; start slow and gradually increase intensity.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Take breaks to allow muscles to recover.
